scope: Controlled actual GameView/GLTF renderer with synthetic snapshots and input. No real user-input, physical-phone, transport, server-capacity or family-playtest claim.
purpose: Integrated controlled prediction, collision/interpolation-driven GLTF gait and lifecycle acceptance. CPU server-parity tests are separate; these are synthetic inputs and snapshots in the actual renderer.

cases.name: Three unacknowledged frames replay the confirmed reload lock
Actual shared-physics wall push settles into idle
Actual shared-physics diagonal slide animates tangential travel
Remote interpolation supplies resolved travel to the actual GLTF
Remote stop keeps gait during delayed travel, then idles
Remote start waits for delayed travel before gait resumes
